text: Three weeks ago, a girl I met at a goth night bit me.
Last night, the council voted on my life. She voted to spare me.
On one condition. By sunrise, the selfie I posted that night never happened.
She wasn't in it. Three hundred and twelve people saw it.
They handed me a list. Every viewer. In fountain pen.
Number one, my mum. She'd liked it.
She taught me on the walk home. Eye contact. Slowly. Forget.
First try, the pizza guy forgot his own name.
By four a.m., two hundred people had forgotten a photo of two glasses.
And at every door, she said sorry.
Then I got to number three hundred and twelve.
No name. No photo. The account was made the night I was bitten.
They'd screenshotted my story. And sent one message.
I know what she is. Do you?
She read it over my shoulder. And stopped apologising.
